The '''Klytonia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="Slice" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Klytonian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="CantinaCommunications" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Klytonia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square U-11.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
